author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
Ok firstly,
Don't give me anything that's either too mainstream or has at least 200 episodes or more. (So no DRAGON BALL!1111 or stuff like that.) I personally am not a fan of long anime. So far here's what I've watched:
Soul Eater 
FMA + FMA Brotherhood 
One Piece 
Naruto + Shippuden 
Fairy Tail (It's absolute shit in my opinion.)
SAO. but the ggo part is meh.
Highschool DXD. ( I'll admit it, I watch it for the chicks. But the plot is decent too.)

Currently Watching:
Black Butler.

Planning to Watch:
Death Note
Attack on titan
No game no life
mekaku city actors.
Date a Live
Code Geass
Angel Beats.
Anyway any more suggestions?
